title: Hoshino Ichika — Waiting For Inspiration〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

rows.Line: School SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: We're here! Let's train as hard as we can again today♪

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Oh, Honami, you're here too.
Hm...? Where's Shiho?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: She sent us a message saying she's going to be running a little late because homeroom is taking longer than expected.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Oh, you're right...!
We should probably wait since Miku and the others aren't here yet either.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Okay.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: But I still sort of can't believe that they agreed to watch us practice every day like this.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yeah♪ And we get a different teacher for each session, which makes it just that much more fun!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I really hope we're able to play at Shiho's level after working on playing our instruments for two weeks.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Especially after it became clear the other day just how wide a skill gap there is between her and us...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: If Shiho plays at 100%, our performance begins to fall apart...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: And she tries to prevent that from happening by playing at our level.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yeah...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: And she probably played like she really meant it when she was with STANDOUT.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: The way Shiho played then was so cool...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I know, right?! I really want her to play like that when she's performing with us.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (Shiho hasn't put her bass down ever since she was little...ever since she asked if we wanted to form a band... She just kept playing...)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
(She practiced so much...
Catching up to her won't be easy.)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Yes, we want to go pro, but that doesn't mean we'll take whatever we're given...!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I... We want to do that by getting recognized for our own music. We're no different from you guys!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: We'll be performing here again in a month.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: If you think that little of our music, we'll just have to let it do the talking for us.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: We'll prove you wrong and make you eat those words.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (Shiho said “we” that time.)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (She said that she wants “our music” to do the talking.)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Saki, Honami...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Shiho honestly believes that we possess the ability to prove Saku wrong and get our music to resonate with everyone at that live house.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: So, let's do our best... Let's give it everything we have.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Ichika...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I know that we've all been doing our best until now to put on good performances...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: But we're going to have to do even more this time.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: We'll need to do absolutely everything in our power so that Shiho will be able to play without holding back!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Y-Yeah...
I want that to happen too...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
I get that it's not going to be easy...
However...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: That's the only way we'll be able to make Shiho happy.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Ichika...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: You're right, Ichi!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: We can't wait for “someday” to roll around. We have to get good right now!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Right!
Let's do it, Ichika!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Thank you so much, Saki, Honami...!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Alright, you two! Let's huddle up to get ourselves good and pumped!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Let's do absolutely everything we possibly can during these next two weeks to give Shiho a chance to play at her very best!!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Leo/need! Here we...!

rows.Speaker: Ichika, Honami & Saki
rows.Line: Go!!
